title: KV cache and autoregressive decoding
hook: Old tokens don't change, so keep their keys and values. The same answer for far less work, paid for in memory.

verified.claim: Generation allocates a cache and passes it per layer.
MiniMax Music 3's model calls init_kv_cache with capacity prompt tokens plus decode limit plus one.
CausalWanSelfAttention appends k and v to a per-layer dict.
Cached and recomputed outputs match to 1.4e-05 and the counts are as printed.
The cost formulas are checked by asserts at n = 40 in the lab.

unchecked: We did not time a real model with and without its cache.
That MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode reaches this class is from reading the model file names and classes; we did not trace the full call path at run time.
The memory table uses illustrative sizes, not a real model's.
